reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: Code reading is factually correct: line 328 performs unchecked access cell_proofs[i * CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB + j]. The 01e property (outputs/01e_PARTIAL_W3B4_1771748827.json, line 680) states: 'Each blob must produce exactly CELLS_PER_EXT_BLOB cell-proof pairs in cells_and_kzg_proofs construction.' However, all three call sites are out of scope per bug bounty rules. The RPC handler path (rest_beacon_api.nim:1108) processes external input but requires the user to have publicly exposed their Beacon API, which is explicitly out-of-scope per BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json conditional_scope.publicly_exposed_api. The validator path (beacon_validators.nim:587) and EL response path (nimbus_beacon_node.nim:2054) both receive data from the Engine API, a semi-trusted boundary (BUG_BOUNTY_SCOPE.json trust_assumptions.engine_api). The Engine API is authenticated via JWT, and issues requiring a compromised local EL are conditional/lower severity. No direct external attack path exists without first requiring out-of-scope prerequisites.
